crossRefs.note: Blessed be Yahweh, the God of Israel, from everlasting and to everlasting! Amen and amen.
Praise be to Yahweh God, the God of Israel, who alone does marvelous deeds.
Blessed be his glorious name forever! Let the whole earth be filled with his glory! Amen and amen.
Blessed be Yahweh, the God of Israel, from everlasting even to everlasting! Let all the people say, “Amen.” Praise Yah!
Then the Levites, Jeshua, and Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabneiah, Sherebiah, Hodiah, Shebaniah, and Pethahiah, said, “Stand up…
For though the fig tree doesn’t flourish, nor fruit be in the vines; the labor of the olive fails, the fields yield no…
Bring us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one. For yours is the Kingdom, the power, and the glory…
Now to the King eternal, immortal, invisible, to God who alone is wise, be honor and glory forever and ever. Amen.

parallels.note: Blessed be Yahweh, the God of Israel, from everlasting even to everlasting. All the people said, “Amen,” and praised…

translations.web: Blessed be Yahweh forever more. Amen, and Amen.
translations.bsb: Blessed be the LORD forever! Amen and amen.
translations.kjv: Blessed be the LORD for evermore. Amen, and Amen.
translations.asv: Blessed be Jehovah for evermore. Amen, and Amen. Psalm 90 A Prayer of Moses the man of God.
